contract: pmf v1 as fed from a comic archive, and dir v1 as fed from an image folder
rule: every archive entry with an image extension (jpg, jpeg, png, webp, avif, jxl, gif, bmp, tif, tiff, heic, heif, any case), except directories, anything under __MACOSX/ and any path component starting with a dot (a leading ./ is not one), contributes the CRC-32 and uncompressed size its central directory records; ComicInfo.xml and the archive's name never contribute
folder_rule: every file directly inside the folder with an image extension, except names starting with a dot, contributes its name and size, and the first and last of them by normalised name contribute their first and last 64 KiB; ComicInfo.xml and the folder's name never contribute
book: pages 001.png to 004.png, page n holding "Sample page 00n\n" repeated 300 times, and a ComicInfo.xml naming Sample Series 05, stored, in that order, as Sample Series 05 v01.cbz

variants.reordered-entries: the entries written in reverse order
variants.edited-comic-info: the ComicInfo.xml also giving a title
variants.changed-page: page 002 holding "Sample page 002, redrawn\n" repeated 300 times
variants.folder: the same entries written as files into a folder named Sample Series 05 v01
